scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,next -c magenta,cyan "python -m uvicorn asgi:app --app-dir apps/api --port 5000" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.migrate: cd apps/api && python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.test:python: cd apps/api && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -q
scripts.check:api: cd apps/api && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -q
scripts.check:web: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.check:all: npm run check:api && npm run check:web
